acceptance: The ratchet accepts removal of a completed entry that matches no tracked file and still rejects removal of one that matches files; unit tests cover both
The results-explorer/ and website/ entries are removed
context:
SUPERSEDED 2026-10-23: PR #3364 (ca810ea0e) removed the `completed` list from quality/comment-policy.json entirely and the checker now rejects the key, so no completed-scope entries (dead or live) remain to prune. Recommend dropping this item; dropping is the owner's call.

Found 2026-10-17 while cleaning up site-removal leftovers (#3105): removing the website/ and results-explorer/ prefixes failed the ratchet, so they were left in place.
description:
The comment-policy ratchet refuses any change that removes a completed scope (scripts/check_comment_policy.py:97-98, "completed scopes cannot be removed"). That protects against relaxing the policy, but it also blocks removing entries for deleted paths. After the site removal, quality/comment-policy.json keeps completed entries for `results-explorer/` (line 252), `website/` (line 257) and `_project/scripts/browser_gate_aggregate.py` (line 132), and the dead entries will keep accumulating.

Allow removing a completed entry when no tracked file matches it at the candidate commit, and keep refusing removal otherwise.
